name: 08022 · Columbus, NJ
findings: ZIP 08022 (Columbus) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08022 (Columbus) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 08022 (Columbus) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).
